title: A map onto a finite type module that is surjective on one stalk is surjective near that point
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $x\in X$. Assume $\mathcal F$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] (1) and that the induced map on stalks $\varphi_x:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is surjective. Then there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $\varphi|_U:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ is surjective as a map of sheaves: for every open $W\subseteq U$ and every $t\in\mathcal F(W)$ there are an open covering $W=\bigcup_iW_i$ and sections $g_i\in\mathcal G(W_i)$ with $\varphi_{W_i}(g_i)=t|_{W_i}$ for all $i$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01B8 (label lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk, line 876) with its proof (choose generators s_1,...,s_n of F over U; lift each germ (s_i)_x along phi_x and shrink U so that s_i = phi(t_i)). Tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags: 01B8,modules-lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk

proof.text: *Step 1 (finite local generators).* By finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] (1), choose an open neighbourhood $U_0$ of $x$, an integer $n\geq0$, and sections $s_1,\ldots,s_n\in\mathcal F(U_0)$ such that the map $q:\mathcal O_{U_0}^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_{U_0}$ sending its basis sections to the $s_i$ is an epimorphism of $\mathcal O_{U_0}$-modules. The case $n=0$ is included: then $q:0\to\mathcal F|_{U_0}$ is an epimorphism.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma 01B8 (label lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk), first sentence; Definition 01B5 (label definition-finite-type)

proof.text: *Step 2 (simultaneous lifts near $x$).* For each $i=1,\ldots,n$, surjectivity of $\varphi_x$ gives a germ $\tau_i\in\mathcal G_x$ with $\varphi_x(\tau_i)=(s_i)_x$. By [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], write $\tau_i=(t_i)_x$ for a section $t_i\in\mathcal G(V_i)$ on some open $V_i\ni x$, and use equality of germs to choose an open $W_i\ni x$ inside $U_0\cap V_i$ on which $s_i|_{W_i}=\varphi_{W_i}(t_i|_{W_i})$. Set $U=U_0\cap\bigcap_{i=1}^nW_i$, an open neighbourhood of $x$ (when $n=0$, set $U=U_0$). Put $u_i=t_i|_U\in\mathcal G(U)$. Then $\varphi_U(u_i)=s_i|_U$ for every $i$.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma 01B8 (label lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk), second sentence: lift each generator germ and shrink U; the finite intersection is made explicit

proof.text: *Step 3 (local lifting of every section).* Restrict $q$ from Step 1 to $U$. Its map $q|_U:\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal F|_U$ is still an epimorphism: for an open $W\subseteq U$, every local lifting supplied for $q$ over $W\subseteq U_0$ stays inside $U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-space-module-exactness-local-lifting] (1), for any open $W\subseteq U$ and $t\in\mathcal F(W)$ there is an open covering $W=\bigcup_jW_j$ and tuples $(a_{1j},\ldots,a_{nj})\in\mathcal O_X(W_j)^n$ such that $t|_{W_j}=\sum_{i=1}^n a_{ij}s_i|_{W_j}$. On $W_j$ put $g_j=\sum_{i=1}^n a_{ij}u_i|_{W_j}\in\mathcal G(W_j)$. Since $\varphi$ is $\mathcal O_X$-linear [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\varphi_U(u_i)=s_i|_U$ (Step 2), $\varphi_{W_j}(g_j)=t|_{W_j}$. This includes $n=0$: local lifts of $q:0\to\mathcal F|_U$ force $t$ to vanish on the cover, and each $g_j$ is the zero section.

split_report.summary: Three steps following Stacks Modules 01B8: take the finite generating epimorphism near x; lift its finitely many generator germs and shrink once; for an arbitrary section, use the existing local-lifting characterization of an epimorphism of module sheaves to obtain local coefficients, then substitute the lifted generators. The empty-generator case is included. No new nodes.
